|quest_reward3_act = 6 |quest_reward3_npc = Lilly Roth }} '''Energy Blade''' is a [[lightning]] [[spell]] that grants a [[buff]] which significantly lowers your maximum [[Energy Shield]] to transform your equipped weapons into [[Swords]] formed from that energy. Casting the spell again removes the buff. Requires all equipped weapons to be [[sword]]s. ==Mechanics== ===Energy Blades stats=== {{Item table |where = items.name = "Energy Blade" AND items.class_id IN ("One Hand Sword", "Two Hand Sword") |large = 1 |weapon = 1 }} * {{c|mod|Energy Blades have (minimum/maximum) Lightning Damage equal to #% of Energy Shield}}: Using Energy Blade grants a buff that completely replaces your existing weapon(s), creating {{il|page=Energy Blade (One Handed Sword)|name=one handed Energy Blade(s)}} or a {{il|page=Energy Blade (Two Handed Sword)|name=two handed Energy Blade}} based on your equipped weapon, at the cost of half your total [[Energy Shield]]. Note that the Lightning Damage granted is based on your current Maximum Energy Shield, which takes the {{c|mod|Buff grants 50% less Maximum Energy Shield}} modifier into account, essentially giving you 50% of the Energy Shield you would have had with the buff off. Lightning Damage gained this way is added to the Energy Blades weapon as local weapon damage, and thus can be used with [[Battlemage]] or (in the one handed case) {{il|Spellblade Support}}. ** The replacement Energy Blade(s) use the same number of hands as the replaced weapon, except in special cases like {{il|Oni-Goroshi}} (a one handed sword that is replaced by a two handed Energy Blade). * By default, a one-handed Energy Blade has 7% base Critical Strike Chance, 1.7 Attacks per Second, and 11 Weapon Range. [[Dual-wielding]] while activating this buff will replace both weapons. ** A two-handed Energy Blade has 7% base Critical Strike Chance, 1.6 Attacks per Second, and 13 Weapon Range; it also inherently has 70% more Local Lightning Damage which is already factored in the weapon damage range when activated. ===Strategy=== * Support Gems: Because Energy Blades is a buff, and does not inherently do damage, this skill cannot be directly supported by [[Support Gems]] that require [[Hits]] or dealing damage. Currently, the only synergistic Support Gems include {{il|Empower Support}} and {{il|Enhance Support}} (or their Awakened variations). {{il|Faster Casting Support}}, {{il|Enlighten Support}}, and {{il|Second Wind Support}} can also be used; however, they serve no real purpose other than when first casting the skill. Deactivating Energy Blade is instant. * Modifiers to the Level or Quality of the Gem from weapons will automatically be negated when Energy Blade is activated, as the weapon becomes replaced. * Energy Blade is considered a normal rarity weapon, potentially relevant for {{il|The Ascetic}}. * One strategy is to use a +gem level weapon (e.g. {{il|Reverberation Rod}}) and a shield with {{c|mod|Marks have #% increased effect}} in the weapon swap, allowing the player to apply a buffed up [[Mark]] skill which persists even after re-activating Energy Blade. * The sword preserves the sockets and links of the weapon it replaces, including [[abyssal socket]]s. * The [[Foulborn]] modifier {{c|foulborn|Your Maximum Energy Shield is Equal to 35% of Your Maximum Life}} on {{il|Ghostwrithe}} will override the less maximum energy shield modifier on Energy Blade. ==Gem level progression== {{Skill progression |c1_abbr = Min Lightning
Damage |c1_header = Energy Blades have minimum Lightning Damage equal to 2% of Energy Shield, plus x |c1_pattern_extract = Energy Blades have minimum Lightning Damage equal to 2%% of Energy Shield, plus (%d+) |c1_pattern_value = %d |c2_abbr = Max Lightning
Damage |c2_header = Energy Blades have maximum Lightning Damage equal to 40% of Energy Shield, plus x |c2_pattern_extract = Energy Blades have maximum Lightning Damage equal to 40%% of Energy Shield, plus (%d+) |c2_pattern_value = %d }} {{Item acquisition}} {{Skill enchantment modifier list|skill=Energy Blades}} Helmet enchantments apply as enchantments on the equipped Energy Blades and are [[local]] mods; the Penetration enchantment on the weapon instead reads {{c|enchanted|Attacks with this Weapon Penetrate #% Lightning Resistance}}. {{Alternate skill effect list}} ==Version history== {{Version history table header}} {{Version history table row|3.29.0| * Energy Blade: Can now only be used if all equipped Weapons are Swords (previously any non-Bow Weapon). }} {{Version history table row|3.28.0| * Quality now provides Buff grants 0-10% increased Attack Speed (replacing Buff grants 0-5% more Maximum Energy Shield). }} {{Version history table row|3.23.0| * Quality now causes the Buff to grant 0-5% more Maximum Energy Shield, instead of causing Energy Blades to have 0-10% increased Critical Strike Chance. }} {{Version history table row|3.19.0| * Energy Blade now has "Two Handed Energy Blades have 70% more Lightning Damage" (previously 50%). }} {{Version history table row|3.16.0| * Energy Blade has been added to the game. * Fixed a bug with Energy Blade where it could delete the player's weapon if they logged out in town after activating it. }} {{Version history table end}} ==References== {{reflist}} {{Navbox Skills}}
